Brussel Noord Basket grew out of a group of young people from Brussels who did not want to simply give up the place where they played sports together.

story.title: From a group of young people to their own club.
story.imageAlt: Basketball training at Brussel Noord Basket
story.p1: The story of Brussel Noord Basket did not begin with a grand plan, but with a group of young people from Brussels' Northern Quarter who mainly wanted one thing: to keep playing basketball.
story.p2: Two years ago, the basketball club where the group played suddenly ceased to exist. Not only were their training sessions and games at risk of disappearing, but so was a place where they met several times a week.
story.p3: Led by Cas, then 18 years old, the group managed to keep the hall temporarily. For a year, the young players could continue training there freely. But their ambition went beyond occasionally playing basketball together. They wanted to compete again, grow together and, above all, build their own club.
story.p4: That is why Brussel Noord Basket was founded in the summer of 2026. What began as an initiative by a group of friends grew into an official basketball club.

club.title: BNB is here.
club.teamText: Brussel Noord Basket started the season with a U18 team. The club officially competes in Basketbal Vlaanderen competitions.
club.recognizedText: BNB is now also recognised as a sports club by the Flemish Community Commission. An important step in the continued development of our organisation.
club.growText: Our ambition is to grow from the current U18 team into a broader basketball programme where even more young people from Brussels can find a place.

youth.p1: For Brussel Noord Basket, it is not only about what happens on the court. We also want to give young people responsibility for their own club, dreams and future.
youth.p2: That is why we want to give players the opportunity to develop further as referees, coaches or even board members. In this way, young people help build not only a basketball team, but also the organisation behind it.
youth.p3: Demand for places to play sports is high in Brussels, while available space is limited. With BNB, we want to help provide an answer: an accessible club where young people can play sports, meet each other and build something together.

support.title: Together, we keep building the club.
support.p1: Building a basketball club takes more than motivation. Hall rental, equipment, game jerseys, coaches and referees all come with costs.
support.p2: With the support of our members, partners and supporters, we want Brussel Noord Basket to keep growing and give more young people in Brussels the opportunity to play basketball.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: Brussel Noord Basket vzw respects your privacy. This privacy statement explains which personal data we process through this website, why we do so and what rights you have.

s2.title: 2. What data do we collect?
s2.intro: When you use the contact form, we may process the following data:
s2.i5: technical data required to process the form securely.

s3.title: 3. Why do we process this data?
s3.p1: We use this data only to handle your question or message, reply to you and provide any necessary follow-up.
s3.p2: Processing is based on our legitimate interest in handling questions and communications about the club. If your message concerns a possible registration or agreement, processing may also be necessary to take steps at your request before entering into a contract.

s4.title: 4. Contact form and Formspree
s4.p1: Our contact form is technically processed through Formspree. When you submit the form, the information you enter is sent to Formspree so that the message can be delivered to us.
s4.p2: Formspree hosts its services through Amazon Web Services in the United States and states that, as a processor, it uses Standard Contractual Clauses for transfers.

s5.title: 5. How long do we keep your data?
s5.p1: We do not retain contact details longer than necessary to handle your question and provide any necessary follow-up. If data must be retained for longer to comply with a legal obligation or for an ongoing case, it is retained only for that purpose.

s6.title: 6. Do we share your data?
s6.p1: We do not sell your personal data. Data is only shared with service providers when necessary for the website or contact form to function, or when we are legally required to do so.

s7.title: 7. Cookies and tracking
s7.p1: This website currently does not use analytics or marketing cookies and contains no advertising trackers. If this changes in the future, we will update this privacy statement and provide a consent mechanism where required.

s8.title: 8. Your rights
s8.p1: You can ask us, among other things, to access, correct or erase your personal data, or to restrict its processing. In certain cases, you can also object to the processing.
s8.p3: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority.

s9.title: 9. Changes
s9.p1: We may update this privacy statement when our website or data processing changes.
